statements.quote: Our AI Cloud Service revenue for the years ended June 30, 2025 and 2024, was $16.4 million and $3.1 million, respectively.
statements.notes: Fiscal 2025 figure; the $3.1 million for fiscal 2024 is a prior-year comparative and is not recorded.

statements.quote: Cost of revenue - AI Cloud Services for the years ended June 30, 2025 and 2024 was $1.3 million and $0.4 million, respectively.
statements.notes: Reported as cost of revenue for the AI Cloud segment, covering electricity, employee benefits and other direct costs. It excludes depreciation and amortization. It is recorded as AI operating cost, but it is not an operating-expense line item.

statements.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.
statements.notes: GPU purchase order for AI Cloud Services, entered after fiscal year-end (August 2025). Delivery is expected by the end of calendar 2025. This is a committed future purchase price, not reported spend. The sentence names no fiscal year, so it is treated as an outlook.

statements.quote: Further in August 2025, we entered into a purchase order with respect to an additional approximately 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $193 million and entered into a further purchase agreement for approximately 1.2k NVIDIA B300 GPUs for a total purchase price of approximately $71.4 million.
statements.notes: B300 GPU purchase agreement after fiscal year-end; same caveats as the B200 order. The two amounts are recorded separately rather than summed.

statements.quote: The increase in total commitments was primarily due to an increase in commitments related to our expansion into HPC and AI services and includes committed capital expenditure on computer hardware and infrastructure related to site development at Horizon 1 at the Childress site and the Sweetwater 1 data center site.
statements.notes: Total commitments as of June 30, 2025 were $368.8 million, stated in the preceding sentence. These are commitments, not capex, and the AI part is not quantified.
